teachingQuestion: What must a relying party verify before trusting a third-party identity assertion?
focalInsight: Federation moves authentication evidence across a trust boundary; validation and local authorization remain with the relying party.
title: Federated trust sequence
caption: The relying party validates the assertion before creating a local session.

nodes.label: Assertion or token
nodes.detail: Carries issuer, audience, claims, time, signature

nodes.label: Relying party
nodes.detail: Validates trust and maps local policy

altSummary: A principal authenticates at an identity provider, which issues an assertion; a relying party validates it and then authorizes access to a resource service.
textFallback: The identity provider authenticates the principal and signs an assertion. The relying party checks the issuer, audience, signature, timing, replay protections, and required claims before making a local authorization decision. OAuth delegation should not be confused with authentication.
